answer: The shortcut is `Ctrl-Shift-b` (`Cmd-Shift-b` on Mac). It runs `Baked Sections: Update`, which re-evaluates every baked section on the current page and rewrites each body with its latest output. I took "frozen query output" to mean baked sections, since the docs don't use the word "frozen". The shortcut is documented in `Baked Sections.md`.
